title: Inconsistent call_deferred behaviour with custom objects
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in v4.5.1.stable.mono.nixpkgs [f62fdbde1]

### System information

Godot v4.5.1.stable.mono (f62fdbde1) - cpe:/o:nixos:nixos:25.05 #1-NixOS SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Thu Nov 13 20:34:41 UTC 2025 on Wayland - Wayland display driver, Multi-window, 3 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 (NVK TU106) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-10750H CPU @ 2.60GHz (12 threads) - 15.38 GiB memory

### Issue description

In some cases, deferred function calls never seem to actually get executed

### Steps to reproduce

1. Create a new scene with the code from the minimal reproduction project attached to the root node
2. Run the scene

Expected Output would be:
```
In Ready Function
Ending Ready Function
This should be deferred
This should also be deferred
This is being deferred outside the ready function
``` 
Actual Output is:
```
In Ready Function
Ending Ready Function
This should be deferred
This should also be deferred
``` 

Also worth noting, if we comment out line 11, the output is
```
In Ready Function
Ending Ready Function
``` 

Suggesting that the call on line 11 is somehow causing the call on line 10 to also run

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

```
extends Node

class TestClass:
	func test_func(param):
		print(param)

func _ready():
	var t = TestClass.new()
	print('In Ready Function')
	t.test_func.call_deferred("This should be deferred")
	deferred_test_func.call_deferred(t)
	internal_deferred_func(t)
	print('Ending Ready Function')

func deferred_test_func(test_obj):
	test_obj.test_func("This should also be deferred")

func internal_deferred_func(test_obj):
	test_obj.test_func.call_deferred("This is being deferred outside the ready function")

```
